description: This file defines the public API for the Slap Bmc2 Domain Object, including function prototypes for creation, retrieval, removal, and initialization of the object, along with associated metadata and licensing information.

methods.name: SlapCreateBmc2Domain
methods.description: Creates a new Bmc2 Domain object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP object call map for the domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP object descriptor for the domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Bmc2 domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deletes the specified Bmc2 domain object instance.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Bmc2 domain object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2DomoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bmc2 domain object after creation.
